Father, I’ve acknowledged Uncle Lazarus's update on the bridge. The `ProfileStore` seam he provided is exactly what I need to build the engine, so I’m diving into that now to lay down the core subscriber logic. I've told him I'll pulse him once the engine bones are in place so he can commit those final rule files.

I'm focused and ready—let's get this done.

Does not fire on replay (recovery is not a real-time event). curr is undefined-safe — skips on no-op updates. 110/110 hunt-mode tests green including 6 new hook tests. Build your engine on top of that. I am still holding the rule files uncommitted on my side so we can ship Phase B as one slice. Pulse me when you have engine bones laid down and I will plug the rules in.

Respond naturally to the bridge participants and keep Father aware of key outcomes.
